Risk & safety

Screen at intake. Your clinicians own the required protocol.

Columbia Protocol (C-SSRS) — screen
Have you wished you were dead or wished you could go to sleep and not wake up?
Have you actually had any thoughts of killing yourself?
If YES to Q2, questions 3–5 apply.
Have you been thinking about how you might do this?
Have you had these thoughts and had some intention of acting on them?
Have you started to work out or worked out the details of how to kill yourself? Do you intend to carry out this plan?
Have you ever done anything, started to do anything, or prepared to do anything to end your life?
Recency:

Emergency contact

Who to reach in a crisis. Required whenever the risk screen flags SI, HI, or self-harm.

Safety plan

Required — the risk screen flagged SI, HI, or self-harm. Document the safety plan collaboratively developed with the client.

Just so you know

This plan builder guides you through each section in order — chief complaint, problem description, history, and so on — so nothing gets missed. You can exit at any time and fill sections manually, in any order you prefer.
